title: Milnor's theorem on Kan complexes
intro: In mathematics, especially algebraic topology, a theorem of Milnor says that the geometric realization functor from the homotopy category of the category Kan of Kan complexes to the homotopy category of the category Top of (reasonable) topological spaces is fully faithful. The theorem in particular implies Kan and Top have the same homotopy category.

title: Milnor conjecture (K-theory)
intro: In mathematics, the Milnor conjecture was a proposal by John Milnor (1970) of a description of the Milnor K-theory (mod 2) of a general field F with characteristic different from 2, by means of the Galois (or equivalently étale) cohomology of F with coefficients in Z/2Z. It was proved by Vladimir Voevodsky (1996, 2003a, 2003b).

title: Min-entropy
intro: The min-entropy, in information theory, is the smallest of the Rényi family of entropies, corresponding to the most conservative way of measuring the unpredictability of a set of outcomes, as the negative logarithm of the probability of the most likely outcome.  The various Rényi entropies are all equal for a uniform distribution, but measure the unpredictability of a nonuniform distribution in different ways.

title: Mining pool
intro: In the context of cryptocurrency mining, a mining pool is the pooling of resources by miners, who share their processing power over a network, to split the reward equally, according to the amount of work they contributed to the probability of finding a block. A "share" is awarded to members of the mining pool who present a valid partial proof-of-work.

title: Ministry of Information Policy (Ukraine)
categories: Lists of government ministers of Ukraine
intro: The Ministry of Information Policy (Ukrainian: Міністерство інформаційної політики, romanized: Ministerstvo informatsiinoi polityky) or MIP was a government ministry in Ukraine established on 2 December 2014. The Honcharuk Government (on 29 August 2019) abolished the Ministerial post.

title: Minkowski's bound
intro: In algebraic number theory, Minkowski's bound gives an upper bound of the norm of ideals to be checked in order to determine the class number of a number field K. It is named for the mathematician Hermann Minkowski.

title: Minkowski's second theorem
intro: In mathematics, Minkowski's second theorem is a result in the geometry of numbers about the values taken by a norm on a lattice and the volume of its fundamental cell. It is named so because it is a strengthening of Minkowski's theorem.

title: Mirror symmetry conjecture
intro: In mathematics, mirror symmetry is a conjectural relationship between certain Calabi–Yau manifolds and a constructed "mirror manifold".  The conjecture allows one to relate the number of rational curves on a Calabi-Yau manifold (encoded as Gromov–Witten invariants) to integrals from a family of varieties (encoded as period integrals on a variation of Hodge structures).
